why: 뒤로 침(4번) → 시작 장을 전투 자세로 바꿈
cond: The body stays side-on facing west (left) the whole time and never turns around; the strike lands in front of the body toward the west.
action: From the wide fighting stance, step the front foot forward and drive a heavy straight punch with the rear fist straight forward at chest height, the shoulder turning into it, then pull back into the fighting stance.

cond: The game moves the body through the air in code, so draw the fall in place and low: the head never rises above its starting height and stays inside the frame.
action: Get knocked off the feet: the body tips backward and drops flat onto the back on the floor in place, arms trailing, ending lying on the back.

cond: The game moves the body through the air in code, so draw the launch in place and low: the head never rises above its starting height and stays inside the frame.
action: Get launched: the body bends back as if lifted off the feet, curls in the air in place, and falls flat onto the back, ending lying on the back.
